Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) – The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
summary: From 9 through 30 April 2019, the National International Health Regulations (IHR) Focal Point of Saudi Arabia reported nine additional cases of Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) infection, including three deaths.

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) – The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
summary: From 1 March through 8 April 2019, the National International Health Regulations (IHR) Focal Point of Saudi Arabia reported 45 additional cases of Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) infection, including 13 deaths.

title: Ebola virus disease – Democratic Republic of the Congo
summary: The Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak response this past week continues to be hampered by insecurity. On 3 May in Katwa, a Safe and Dignified Burial (SDB) team was violently attacked following the completion of a burial for a deceased EVD case.

title: Measles – European Region
summary: In the first two months of 2019, 34 300 measles cases have been reported in 42 countries of the WHO European Region, including 13 measles-related deaths in three countries (Albania, Romania and Ukraine).

title: Ebola virus disease – Democratic Republic of the Congo
summary: The operating environment has become increasingly insecure and socio-politically complex. Insecurity remains a major impediment to ensuring timely response interventions in the affected communities.

title: Chikungunya – Congo
summary: On 9 February 2019, the government of Congo officially declared an outbreak of chikungunya virus disease.
